shared_core_edit_gate: Wait for sole cap128k learner 60642 to exit its fixed budget and audit/save its terminal log; do not hot-change workers or evaluation dependencies.

fixed_configuration.policy: unchanged learned categorical sampling; no override

implementation_requirements: Default stride 1 preserves existing game behavior and original packages.
Environment emits four frames selected from a 3*stride+1 raw screen history; no internal game data enters policy.
Vector workers forward configuration and remain CPU-only.
Snapshots save complete raw history and reject mismatched timing/stride/history shape before mutating emulator; peers validate all entries before installing.
PPO records stride, includes it in validation-protocol identity and passes it to training and evaluation; changed protocol resets old selection records.
Evaluation and watch default to checkpoint stride; result metadata states actual stride/timing.
Recording defaults to checkpoint stride but retains every raw action frame; metadata states actual stride/timing.
Inspection reconstructs frame offsets [-3*stride,-2*stride,-stride,0], validates metadata and reproduces every categorical action.
Legacy checkpoints and replay metadata default to stride 1; no original model/package/replay mutation.
No training run before integrity gates and secondary audit.

gates_in_order.name: regression
gates_in_order.require: All existing tests plus stride history, snapshot/curriculum compatibility, vector scheduling, PPO protocol identity, replay stack alignment and malformed-stride tests pass.

gates_in_order.name: original_compatibility
gates_in_order.require: Exact full game dictionaries equal archived source primary.

gates_in_order.name: spaced_reproduction
gates_in_order.require: Exact full game dictionaries equal temporal-e0da-50k-spaced.json; ordinary evaluator, not TemporalPolicy wrapper.

gates_in_order.name: uncapped_replay
gates_in_order.require: Exact complete game outcome plus zero mismatches for all replay actions under frozen model and declared history.

gates_in_order.name: secondary_validation
gates_in_order.require: Run all requested games; disqualify the whole suite if any is incomplete. No seed or timing sweep.

evaluation_package_policy: If a self-contained adapted package is needed, copy model bytes unchanged into a new evaluation-only directory with explicit source provenance and timing/stride config, resume_supported=false and no optimizer. Never edit the original source config or claim additional training.
promotion_rule: Only after all gates pass and 70 games complete, compare level-reach counts lexicographically from level 10 down to 2, then mean score, against the preserved original-timing 70-game reference. A tie or loss does not replace it. Any promoted result is validation-only; one high-level reach is not mastery.
final_tests: Seeds 40000-40099 remain unused. If a fully verified validation configuration reaches displayed Level 10, freeze it before the goal's 100 complete fresh games; no final-test model selection.
